seoTitle: How to Create a Free Brevo Account, Step by Step
metaDescription: Sign up for Brevo's free marketing plan without a payment card: create your login, verify your email, and land in your new dashboard.
intro: Brevo's homepage sells itself as one platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM, and the free tier is genuinely free to start — no card required at signup. That matters if you just want to poke around the dashboard before committing to anything. This guide walks through the actual signup screens: creating your login, confirming the email address that owns the account, and what to expect once you're through verification.

steps.heading: Start from the Brevo homepage
steps.body: Go to brevo.com and use either the Sign Up Free button in the top navigation or the matching button in the hero section. The homepage itself is worth a glance before you commit — it lays out what's bundled into the platform (email marketing, SMS, WhatsApp, and a shared customer data view), which is useful context since the plan you land on by default is scoped around those channels.

image.caption: The Brevo homepage, with the Sign Up Free button in the top corner and a preview of the dashboard you'll be setting up next.

steps.heading: Create your login
steps.body: The signup screen gives you three paths in: sign up with Google, sign up with Apple, or enter an email address and password directly. The page header says it plainly — "Free to use, no credit card required" — so if a screen ever prompts for billing details during this stage, you've wandered into a paid-plan flow by mistake. If you're entering credentials manually, Brevo enforces a minimum password length of 8 characters, shown as a live checklist item under the field as you type.

image.caption: The account creation screen: Google or Apple sign-up at the top, or an email and password entered directly below.

steps.heading: Click Create your account
steps.body: Once your email and password pass validation, click Create your account at the bottom of the form. This also serves as your agreement to Brevo's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, both linked directly under the button, so it's worth a skim before you click if you haven't used Brevo before.

steps.heading: Verify the email address you signed up with
steps.body: Immediately after account creation, Brevo sends a confirmation link to the address you entered and shows a "Let's verify your email address" screen with shortcuts to open Gmail or Outlook directly. If the message doesn't show up right away, check your spam folder — Brevo's own screen suggests this first, followed by options to resend the email or restart signup with a different address entirely.

image.caption: The email verification screen, with one-click shortcuts into Gmail or Outlook and a resend option if the message doesn't arrive.

steps.heading: Complete your profile details
steps.body: After clicking the confirmation link in your inbox, you're returned to Brevo to fill in the remaining account details: your name, company name, website, physical address, and a phone number confirmed by an SMS code. None of this is optional — Brevo uses it to configure your sender identity correctly and to stay compliant with regional email regulations, since a real business address is required on outbound marketing email under laws like CAN-SPAM.

steps.heading: Land in your new dashboard
steps.body: Once your profile is complete, Brevo spins up your workspace and drops you into the main dashboard, where you'll build contact lists, design your first campaign, and check your sending limits. Free accounts come with a capped daily sending allowance rather than unlimited volume, so if you plan to test at any real scale, check the current limit in your account settings before you build out a big send.

faq.question: Do I need a credit card to sign up for Brevo's free plan?
faq.answer: No. The signup screen states plainly that it's free to use with no credit card required, and none of the account-creation or verification steps ask for billing details.

faq.question: Can I sign up using Google or Apple instead of a password?
faq.answer: Yes. The signup screen offers Sign up with Google and Sign up with Apple as one-click alternatives to creating a password manually.

faq.question: What happens if I don't verify my email?
faq.answer: Your account setup stalls at the verification screen. Brevo sends a confirmation link and won't let you complete your profile or reach the dashboard until you click it.

faq.question: What information does Brevo ask for after email verification?
faq.answer: Your name, company name, website, physical business address, and a phone number confirmed by SMS. This is used to configure your sender profile and meet regional email compliance requirements.

faq.question: How many emails can I send on the free plan?
faq.answer: Free accounts get a capped daily sending allowance rather than unlimited volume — check your account settings for the current limit, since Brevo has adjusted free-tier limits over time.
